PreToolUse.description: Reminder to review changes before git push (non-blocking)

hooks.command:
node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input&&i.tool_input.file_path;if(p&&fs.existsSync(p)){const dir=process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR||process.cwd();let ws=null;if(p.includes('apps/api'))ws='apps/api';else if(p.includes('apps/worker'))ws='apps/worker';else if(p.includes('packages/music-core'))ws='packages/music-core';if(ws){const wsDir=path.join(dir,ws);try{execSync('uv run ruff format "'+p+'"',{cwd:wsDir,stdio:'pipe'})}catch(e){}try{const r=execSync('uv run ruff check "'+p+'"',{cwd:wsDir,encoding:'utf8',stdio:['pipe','pipe','pipe']});if(r.trim())process.stderr.write('[ruff] '+r.trim()+'
')}catch(e){if(e.stdout&&e.stdout.trim())process.stderr.write('[ruff] '+e.stdout.trim()+'
');}}}}catch(err){process.stderr.write('[ruff-hook] '+err.message+'
');}console.log(d);})"

PostToolUse.description: Run ruff format then ruff check on edited .py files; surface errors to stderr

hooks.command:
node -e "const fs=require('fs');let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input&&i.tool_input.file_path;if(p&&fs.existsSync(p)){const c=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const lines=c.split('
');const hits=[];lines.forEach((l,idx)=>{if(/console\.log/.test(l)&&!///.*console\.log/.test(l))hits.push((idx+1)+': '+l.trim());});if(hits.length){process.stderr.write('[Hook] WARNING: console.log found in '+p+'
');hits.slice(0,5).forEach(h=>process.stderr.write('  '+h+'
'));process.stderr.write('[Hook] Remove before committing.
');}}}catch(err){process.stderr.write('[ts-hook] '+err.message+'
');}console.log(d);})"

PostToolUse.description: Warn on console.log in .ts/.tsx files after edits (non-blocking)
